content.body:
Based on British observations of the successful Russian BT tank, the A13 was designed around the novel Christie suspension system, resulting in a fast tank with a good off-road performance. Coupled with its high-velocity 2 pounder main gun, this made the A13 Cruiser series more than a match for any tank of its time.
Very thinly armored, the in-game model is actually the A13 Mk II (or Cruiser Tank Mk IV A) with supplemental armor plates on the turret and the nose. The tank was heavily used throughout the fighting in Belgium and later in North Africa until replaced by its descendant the A15.
The A13 is an exemplary light tank with a gun capable of killing medium tanks. The green color and lethal main armament make it excellent for ambush, although the characteristically weak British optics somewhat negate the range advantage of the QF 2 pdr gun. Drive it like an armored car. Pay close attention to your situation and don't stand and fight anything. Don't be afraid to stop and look around, as long as you're in cover; the green coloring will hide you from cursory examination.
Fear air attack, since your top armor can be penetrated even by aircraft machineguns. Keep your A13 hull down to protect your tracks, and under trees to prevent aircraft spotting you. Use your speed to flank the enemy while out of visual range and to locate a quiet position that allows hitting heavier panzers in the side or rear as they pass by. The camoflage paint is so good that some careless German tankers will not detect you until it is too late.
Control Variations:
The driver may zoom his view through the open view slit (numpad . or Del key) but closing it blocks vision completely. The tank carries only AP ammunition and has no range adjustment or gradation in the gunsight.
